description: BerryTrace System and AI Kernel Error catalog mapping file. Helps AI troubleshoot issues and explain runtime errors.

errors.message: AI 响应超时，请稍后重试或简化您的请求
possible_causes: Network connection bottleneck to LLM endpoint
Prompt context is too large causing long reasoning cycles
API service provider experiencing heavy load
actions: Check network to berrytrace.getdear.cn or custom endpoint
Start a new clean chat session to reduce history tokens

errors.symptom: HTTP status code 401, 403, 429, or general API key errors
errors.message: API 调用失败，请检查 API 密钥和网络连接
possible_causes: Invalid or expired OpenAI/BerryTrace API key
Insufficient balance on the API account
actions: Go to Settings panel in Main Window UI and verify API key settings
Verify API key balance on the provider platform

errors.symptom: Fetch failed or server connection refused
errors.message: 网络连接失败，请检查您的网络设置
possible_causes: No internet connection or local proxy blocking requests
actions: Test web navigation to the API endpoint in browser
Configure system proxy settings if required

errors.message: API 调用频率超限，请稍后重试
possible_causes: High frequency of API requests from the current IP

errors.message: 对话内容过长，请开启新会话或删减历史消息
possible_causes: Historical message length exceeds model's context window size
Extremely large active files or directory trees are loaded into prompt
actions: Use new session to reset history context
Close unnecessary tabs in the workspace editor

errors.symptom: Plugin API namespace not found error
possible_causes: The SDK attempted to call a namespace that is not registered in api-dispatcher.ts
actions: Check that the controller implementing the namespace is added to the controllers Map

possible_causes: The SDK requested a method name that is missing from the switch-case in the controller execution method
actions: Verify method implementation switch cases in electron/plugins/controllers/
